Container.Name: unraid-mcp
Container.Overview: Internal GraphQL-backed Unraid MCP sidecar for codex-terminal. This container should not publish its MCP port to the LAN.
Container.Requires: Create the Docker network first: docker network create codex-mgmt. Do not add a host port mapping for 6970 unless you intentionally expose MCP.

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: Persistent MCP state and generated credential files.

Config.Name: Unraid API URL
Config.Description: Unraid GraphQL endpoint. Use http or https to match your Unraid WebUI/API scheme. Unraid 7.2+ includes the API; pre-7.2 requires Unraid Connect.

Config.Name: Unraid API Key
Config.Description: Scoped Unraid API key. Avoid ADMIN by default.

Config.Name: Unraid MCP Bearer Token
Config.Description: Bearer token clients must use to call this MCP server. Must match codex-terminal.
